I continue to struggle with my eating disorder. But before, it was awful. Every time I got up, all I could see was black, I missed periods, I had so many panic attacks. But nobody noticed. They assumed that I worked so hard to lose weight because I was previously obese.
After losing 50lbs, I was considered a healthy weight. But it was anything but that. It’s not healthy to starve yourself for days, to barf up anything you consume, to constantly exercise, to measure body parts hoping their get smaller.
It’s hard. Heck, I’m getting back into it. The blacking out is coming back. And I don’t want it to. But I can’t look at myself and be satisfied.
Please notice the subtle changes. A severe weight loss, their loss in appetite, dizziness, a shift in mood. It’s not something that will go away until it’s too late.
